s1.syndrome_frame: Abdominal and pelvic pain with a renal mass and vascular involvement
salient_findings: Right renal mass with fat attenuation
Fatty tumor thrombus in the right renal vein
key_facts: 66-year-old woman
History of endometrioid endometrial carcinoma
Abdominal and pelvic pain
Physical examination was unremarkable
Laboratory studies were within normal limits
Creatinine level of 0.81 mg dl–1
Right renal mass with areas of fat attenuation
Lesion contained visible vessels extending into the renal cortex
Fatty tumor thrombus within the right renal vein
Thrombus extended to the confluence with the inferior vena cava
No other masses or enlarged lymph nodes were identified

shortlist.label: Renal cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Renal mass with areas of fat attenuation and vascular involvement

shortlist.label: Angiomyolipoma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of fat attenuation within the renal mass

shortlist.label: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Most common type of renal cell carcinoma, consistent with patient's age and presentation

shortlist.label: Papillary renal cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Possible diagnosis given the presence of a renal mass and vascular involvement

shortlist.label: Chromophobe renal cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Less common type of renal cell carcinoma, but still a plausible diagnosis given the patient's age and presentation

raw.rationale: The presence of a right renal mass with areas of fat attenuation is highly suggestive of angiomyolipoma, a benign tumor that typically contains fat and vessels.

rejected.label: Renal cell carcinoma
rejected.why: While renal cell carcinoma can present with a renal mass, the presence of fat attenuation within the mass is more characteristic of angiomyolipoma.

rejected.label: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma
rejected.why: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma is the most common type of renal cell carcinoma, but it does not typically contain fat attenuation.

rejected.label: Papillary renal cell carcinoma
rejected.why: Papillary renal cell carcinoma can have various imaging appearances, but fat attenuation is not a typical feature.

rejected.label: Chromophobe renal cell carcinoma
rejected.why: Chromophobe renal cell carcinoma is a rare type of renal cell carcinoma, and it does not typically contain fat attenuation.
